1503	# run_cell_with_per_cell_retry invokes run_one_cell with per-cell retry logic

1505	# linked via attempt_of/superseded_by. Returns the final cell_dir.
1506	# initial_attempt_of="" disables initial attempt_of tracking.
1507	run_cell_with_per_cell_retry() {
1508	  local out="$1" profile_id="$2" profile_file="$3"
1509	  local framework="$4" dataset="$5" dataset_dir="$6" task="$7"

1513	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1514	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1515	  local attempt=1
1516	  local prior_cell_dir="${initial_attempt_of}"
1517	
1518	  while :; do
1519	    local cell_dir
1520	    cell_dir="$(run_one_cell "${out}" "${profile_id}" "${profile_file}" \
1521	                  "${framework}" "${dataset}" "${dataset_dir}" "${task}" \
1522	                  "${rep_idx}" "${total_reps}" "${adapter}" "${prior_cell_dir}" \
1523	                  "${te_ver}" "${hd}" "${interrupted_flag}")"
1524	
1525	    if [[ ! -f "${cell_dir}/report.json" ]]; then
1526	      # No result to check, just return the cell
1527	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1528	      return 0
1529	    fi
1530	
1531	    local error_class final_status
1532	    error_class="$(jq -r '.error_class // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1533	    final_status="$(jq -r '.final_status // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1534	
1535	    # If non-transient error or success, stop retrying
1536	    if [[ -z "${error_class}" ]] || ! is_transient_error_class "${error_class}"; then
1537	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1538	      return 0
1539	    fi
1540	
1541	    # If max attempts reached, mark final cell with transient_exhausted and stop
1542	    if (( attempt >= max_attempts )); then
1543	      local tmp
1544	      tmp="$(mktemp)"
1545	      jq '. + {final_status:"transient_exhausted"}' "${cell_dir}/report.json" >"${tmp}"
1546	      mv "${tmp}" "${cell_dir}/report.json"
1547	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1548	      return 0
1549	    fi
1550	
1551	    # Transient error and more attempts available: sleep and retry
1552	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts}); sleeping ${backoff}s before retry"
1553	    sleep "${backoff}"
1554	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1555	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1556	    prior_cell_dir="${cell_dir}"
1557	  done
1558	}
